narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To communicate a significant scientific shift in understanding genetic mutations. The video explains that mutations are not purely random but influenced by the physical structure and activity of the genome, specifically citing recent research comparing African and European populations. The intent is to educate the audience on modern evolutionary biology through a fast-paced, social-media-friendly science lecture format.
